_doc: Header synonym dictionary for join-key detection (Excel統合ツール).
Headers are matched AFTER headerNorm(): NFKC -> lowercase -> strip whitespace and symbols ※*＊★☆◆■●・:：_-‐()（）［］[]【】「」『』<>〈〉.,、。?？!！'"/／ -> strip note words (see noteWords).
Each rule: re = JavaScript regex source (tested with flag 'u' against the normalized header), score = header score 0..1.
Rules of a type are tried in order; the highest score wins. 'negative' regexes veto the type (score 0) even if a positive rule matched.
'entityWords' mark WHOSE key it is (学生/応募者 vs 社員/面接官). They do not change the type; they are kept as column.entity so that two entities in one sheet can be told apart and paired across files.
family groups types that are joinable with each other (e.g. 応募者ID in file A vs 学生ID in file B).

nonKeyHeaders._doc: Headers that are never keys: they veto VALUE-ONLY typing (a 区分 column full of kanji words must not become 氏名). Regex sources, tested against headerNorm().
